orders.thesis: AI-demand signals (SpaceX $40B GPU debt, Meta $95B raise with Nvidia participating, MS data-center power gap raised) support capex durability; no earnings until late Nov so avoids the binary earnings week. Stock is -5.6% over 20d, near the low end of its range.

PAGE DATE: Oct 26, 2026 (published 11:06 AM, per the article header)

**Catalysts cited on the page:** Nvidia rose 3.1% in morning trading, reaching $217.56 after opening at $213.08. The article attributes the move to several AI-demand signals:

- **Anthropic's public IPO filing**, which investors read as an endorsement of continued AI infrastructure buildout.
- **SpaceX debt disclosure:** SpaceX confirmed it raised $40 billion in debt to buy Nvidia GPUs for AI workloads, described as one of the most direct demand signals from a single customer in recent months.
- **Morgan Stanley:** raised it

summary: First session. Started 100% cash. The digest and searches showed that MSFT and GOOGL reported after the close on Oct 28, but I couldn't find or read the results. AMZN reports Oct 29 after close and AAPL next week. META reported Oct 21. I avoided those binary-event names. I opened small positions: NVDA 8% and AVGO 8%, with 15-day horizons, 8% stops and 14% targets. The rest, 84%, is cash. The AI-chip thesis rests on one read page, an Investing.com piece from Oct 26 on AI-demand catalysts. Tool quirks: web_search hit its limit after about 10 calls, and read_page failed on benzinga and cnbc but worked on investing.com.
